compounds.quote: > The acidic taste of Cottage cheese is due largely to lactic acid, which is present at a concentration in the range 124-452 mg/kg; other acids present include formic (23-306 mg/kg) and acetic (11-292 mg/kg), while the concentrations of propionic and butyric acids are <1 mg/kg (Brocklehurst and Lund, 1985)

ammonia.reason: Fresh unripened curd with no proteolysis or deamination, no ammonia quantified.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk with no p-cresol or indole quantified.

bitter.reason: Fresh acid curd with minimal proteolysis to hydrophobic bitter peptides.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium mold and no 2-heptanone 2-nonanone methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Fresh high-moisture unaged cheese with minimal Maillard browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus diacetylactis citrate metabolism gives diacetyl 210-780 ug/100g.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric acid <1 mg/kg and no lipolysis in fresh skim acid curd.

creaminess.reason: Curd in 11.5% fat cream dressing gives smooth coating despite 4.3% total fat.

crumbliness.reason: Soft discrete acid grains in liquid dressing, not pressed to fracture.

firmness.reason: Very high moisture 79.8% loose acid-coagulated grains in cream.

floral_honey.reason: No phenylacetaldehyde or 2-phenylethanol quantified in fresh cottage.

fruity.reason: No ethyl butanoate or ethyl hexanoate quantified, negligible esterification.

goaty.reason: Cow milk with no 4-methyloctanoic or 4-ethyloctanoic goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: No aging and no Strecker aldehydes 2-methylbutanal 3-methylbutanal found.

melt.reason: Acid isoelectric curd pH 5.05 does not flow, only softens on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol or 1-octen-3-one quantified in fresh product.

oil_off.reason: Low 4.3% fat emulsified in dressing, no free oil separation.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked with no guaiacol or phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid 124-452 mg/kg plus acetic 72-150 ug/g at pH 5.05 from mesophilic starter.

stretch.reason: Unstretched acid curd with no aligned para-casein network.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low dimethyl sulfide 20-25 ppb plus gentle cooking of cut curd.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and sweet cream dressing partly offsets lactic acidity.

umami.reason: No ripening proteolysis, very low free glutamate and peptides.
